answers.goal: I would love to be a cinematographer. Genuinely my life would be complete if I could just do that for the rest of my life. But I also love producing, working on the legal and business affairs of it all because negotiating is unfortunately too much fun. But like Guillermo and Autumn, I want someone like me and someone with a similar name to be on the big screen at the end of the credits.
answers.drew: The technical aspect of making films. The Odyssey right now has me geeking. I need to see the new IMAX cameras in person and I would die if I got to see the blimp. Although The Odyssey is an amazing story, literal epic, I am more excited and engaged at all the technical advancements they have made for this film. That and I just love how shots alone can say so much within a story without ever stating a single word.
answers.seeking: Anyone and everyone. I would love to be on more sets. I would love to produce things with and for people. I just want to be on the creative side once more with production, it's legit my happy place.
answers.inspiration: Guillermo del Toro (my mexican dream) and Autumn Durald Arkapaw (literal dream to be like her lol)
answers.favorite: Movie: Iron Man / Show: Heated Rivalry
